name: sj1-3533ng
description: Same Sky SJ1-3533NG right-angle through-hole 3.5 mm stereo jack, three contacts and no internal switches.
watch_out_for: Exact no-switch variant: S=sleeve/common (manufacturer pin 1), T=tip/left (pin 2), R=ring/right (pin 3); there are no switch terminals 4/5. The authoritative JLC listing is https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/CUI-SJ13533NG/C4992459. The restored offline JLC catalog reports 323 units and the LCSC retail listing showed 229 units on 2026-09-16; inventory is time-sensitive and must still pass the current §9.26 check at build time.

provenance.source: Same Sky manufacturer datasheet pin mapping; KiCad 9 exact CUI footprint cross-checked to the manufacturer recommended layout
